rows.statement: The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
You can globally disable tracing in code with set_tracing_disabled(True)
You can not globally disable tracing in code with set_tracing_disabled(True)
Traces represent a single end-to-end operation of a "workflow".
For example, AgentSpanData contains information about the Agent, GenerationSpanData contains information about the LLM generation, etc.
Each model turn is wrapped in a turn_span().
Each model turn is not wrapped in a turn_span().
Function tool calls are each wrapped in function_span()
Function tool calls are not each wrapped in function_span()
Audio outputs (text-to-speech) are wrapped in a speech_span()
Audio outputs (text-to-speech) are not wrapped in a speech_span()
You can set this name if you use trace, or you can configure the name and other properties with the RunConfig.
You can not set this name if you use trace, or you can configure the name and other properties with the RunConfig.
In addition, you can set up custom trace processors to push traces to other destinations (as a replacement, or secondary destination).
In addition, you can not set up custom trace processors to push traces to other destinations (as a replacement, or secondary destination).
Sometimes, you might want multiple calls to run() to be part of a single trace.
You can use the trace() function to create a trace.
You can not use the trace() function to create a trace.
You can also manually call trace.start() and trace.finish().
You can not also manually call trace.start() and trace.finish().

nli-claims/stress.note: Held-out evaluation set. Written on 2026-09-12 AFTER the comparator was finished and BEFORE it was run against any of these. Every entry carries `truth`, which is the label a careful reader would assign, and `predicted_system`, which is what I expected this implementation to actually output, recorded in advance. The gap between those two columns is the measurement. Nothing in the comparator may be tuned to make these pass: the moment it is tuned on this set, the set stops being evidence.
